1.

I have heard of a land where righteousness dwells, Where sin, nor sorrows, reach, Where no cry is heard, where no tear is shed, Where the weary find rest and peace.

2.

I have heard of a throng in shining white, A praising, jubilant host, Who by grace have now received all they call their own, Who by grace, by grace alone, are found there.

3.

I have heard of a God who has loved us, though We have deserved His holy wrath. And so great was His grace toward the poor sinner, That He sent His only begotten Son.

4.

He can save each one who on Him will believe, Who in Him seeks help for his need, He who gives to the weary, burdened ones rest, And to the hungry living bread.

5.

It was God’s only begotten, Beloved, Holy One, Who here gave His precious blood, Who in love for us bore death’s suffering, O, my friend, that you this might understand!
